title: acrolasia ctenophora
intro: Acrolasia ctenophora, commonly known as Kukui, is a plant species native to Hawaii and Southeast Asia, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Acrolasia ctenophora include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
